evidence.quote: It is not a security boundary against hostile agent code.
Until it is, an agent that has any tool capability potentially has access to environment-inherited credentials in its subprocess image.
Production sandboxing for hostile code, multi-peer operation across untrusted hosts, and on-chain settlement are not.
The gap between trusted-local and a production sandbox for hostile code is the largest remaining isolation gap.
The implementation operates over a single host today.
Publication to a transparency log—Sigstore Rekor or an in-toto-compatible log—is the next step but has not landed.
On-chain settlement is the most speculative primitive.
